summary: Completed full testing of Assets Module (Module 4). Found and fixed a critical bug where employee/site dropdowns were empty in the Issue dialog due to page_size=200 exceeding the API max of 100. All 37 backend tests passed. All frontend flows (create, view, edit, issue, return, mark-as-lost, delete, filter, search) working after fix.

issues: Purchase Date, Issue Date, and Return Date fields use browser native `type='date'` picker (showing mm/dd/yyyy placeholder) instead of shadcn calendar component - minor UX inconsistency

bugs_fixed.issue: CRITICAL: IssuancesTab called `/employees?page_size=200` and `/sites?page_size=200`, but both APIs enforce `le=100` max page_size. This returned 422 errors, causing empty employee and site dropdowns in the Issue Asset dialog. Users could not issue any asset to an employee or site.
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed `page_size=200` to `page_size=100` in both API calls in the IssuancesTab useEffect.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Frontend hardcoded page_size=200 for preloading employees/sites, exceeding the API-enforced maximum of 100 (le=100 Pydantic validator). This resulted in 422 Unprocessable Entity on both /employees and /sites calls, leaving the dropdowns empty and blocking issuance completely.

action_items: Consider using shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component for date fields instead of browser native type='date' inputs for UI consistency (minor UX)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: AssetDetail.js IssuancesTab used page_size=200 for employees/sites preload - exceeded API max of 100
The TestIssuanceSite test class teardown was not returning active issuances before deleting the asset - fixed to return first then delete
The IssuancesTab loads all employees (up to 100) into memory at once - for large orgs this may need pagination/search-as-you-type for the employee/site selects

rca_of_issue.bug: Issue Asset dialog employee/site dropdowns always empty
rca_of_issue.root_cause: AssetDetail.js IssuancesTab called `/employees?page_size=200` and `/sites?page_size=200`. Both API endpoints have `page_size: int = Query(le=100)` Pydantic validation. Value 200 > 100 caused 422 Unprocessable Entity responses. Frontend silently swallowed errors (.catch(console.error)), leaving employees=[] and sites=[]. When user opened Issue dialog, the Select had no options.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Navigate to any available asset > Issuance History tab > Issue Asset button > Select Employee dropdown shows empty list
